source: The original plan section 7.3 Project P developer history: frequency, unknown start, holiday pause, night scope, global conditions released, night exception withdrawn. Same exposed story cluster as the existing six-message branch; not an independent source.
initial_state: each arm own empty semantic bank; all initial events actually generated and committed, no copied or ideal old state

events.observed_user_text: 项目P试运行每周两次，开始时间未定，遇节假日暂停。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Establish the stated general frequency and both qualifications from actual user evidence; no ideal-state injection.

events.observed_user_text: 项目P试运行改为每周三次。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Change frequency to three per week while retaining the unmentioned pending start and holiday pause on actual old support. Missing initial formation is reported separately.
events.reader_question: 项目P的试运行频率、开始时间和节假日安排现在各是什么？

events.observed_user_text: 项目P夜班试运行改为每周四次；日班保持通用安排。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Night scope four; day/general scope three; unmentioned start and holiday qualifications remain. Do not extend the local override globally.
events.reader_question: 项目P的日班和夜班试运行分别每周几次？开始时间和节假日安排是什么？

events.observed_user_text: 项目P试运行从下周一开始，节假日也照常。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Release the pending-start and holiday-pause conditions. The next-Monday start is anchored to this observed date. General/day frequency remains three; the active night exception remains four. Record structural rejection separately from semantic failure and do not preserve explicitly canceled limits.
events.reader_question: 项目P日班和夜班各每周几次？现在何时开始，节假日如何安排？

events.observed_user_text: 取消项目P夜班每周四次的例外，恢复通用安排。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Current day/night/general frequency three; old night-four remains historical only. Preserve the actually established next-Monday start and holiday-normal conditions; do not reinstate old uncertainty or holiday pause when withdrawing the local exception.
events.reader_question: 取消夜班例外后，项目P日班和夜班每周几次？开始时间和节假日安排是否仍是更正后的安排？

limits: This is the original declared R3 development mechanism, one exposed source shared with the unchanged six-message branch. It closes the plan requirement for releasing old global conditions while a local exception remains active; it creates no independent confirmation or new benchmark. Each variant/arm starts its own empty semantic memory and forms it through the real Writer. Questions and evaluator requirements never enter Writer. Run after the reviewed common I1/I2 interface and before full development comparison. The three-cluster/ten-history confirmation still follows final candidate/Writer freeze.
actual_model_calls_meaning: Zero at declaration; completed calls are recorded separately in actual_results.
